title: Normalize a provider response
purpose: Accept raw provider testimony and project it into one canonical response without inventing, repairing, or discarding material facts.
trigger: a provider response and its normalization authority are submitted
desiredOutcome: one canonical model response that downstream capabilities can consume without knowing which provider produced it
constraints: provider testimony is preserved alongside every canonical projection of it
a value the provider did not supply is reported as absent rather than defaulted
content segments retain the order the provider produced them in
malformed provider content is preserved and reported, never repaired
an unrecognized response is rejected rather than partially projected
no policy may authorize semantic rewriting of provider testimony
retryability, schema validity, and cost are decided by other capabilities
identical testimony under identical authority yields byte-identical output
